text:
Butter Chicken🇮🇳

Ingredients:

2lb of cubed chicken thighs 
1tbsp grated garlic
1tbsp grated ginger
2-3 tbsp Whole Fat Yogurt
Juice from one lemon

Homemade spice mix:

1/2tsp paprika
1/2tsp turmeric
1tsp cumin
1tsp cayenne
1tsp chili powder
1 tsp Salt
2 tsp garam masala

Sauce:
1tbsp butter + 1tbsp oil OR 2tbsp Ghee
1 diced onion
1tbsp garlic
1/2tbsp ginger
1/2tsp Garam masala
1/2tsp coriander
1/2tsp cumin
1 cup plain tomato sauce, canned tomatoes, or crushed tomatoes. 
1 cup heavy cream

Add sugar to taste to balance out the tanginess from tomatoes

#butterchicken #indianfood
